---
title: "D6 Pricing"
order: 0
---

**Status: in progress.**

Pricing is inventoried as a deterministic calculation tool, not a model
([D0](../d0-summary.qmd#why-pricing-is-listed-as-a-tool-not-a-model)). It still gets a
chapter, because its output drives decisions and its inputs need governing.

The chapter will cover the profit waterfall and the rate that clears the
{{< var market.roe_hurdle >}} ROE hurdle; the market assumptions in
`shared.config.MARKET` and how a change to one is controlled; the PD it takes from the
scorecard (D3); the mispricing measure over the booked book and where it concentrates;
the engine's unit tests in place of a performance section; and how the portal's what-if
equals the batch run.

The chapter follows the [template](../index.qmd#the-template), with the parts that assume
estimated parameters replaced by the tests that pin the arithmetic.
